verdict.outcome_rationale: This was a genuine agent-fault failure and the verifier's FAIL is correct. The verifier reported binary_reward 0 after finding no /app/solver.py at grading time [1][2], exiting before any nRMSE evaluation [3]. The task explicitly required implementing a 1D compressible Navier-Stokes solver, meeting an nRMSE bar below 0.0125, and writing it to /app/solver.py [4], and the harness artifact list names that same path as the sole deliverable [5]. The full trajectory contains only the user prompt (step 0) and one agent reply (step 1): the agent returned a long markdown answer embedding a WENO5/RK4 implementation under a '### `solver.py`' heading but recorded zero tool_tokens, with no file-write or shell steps anywhere in the run [6][7]. Because nothing was persisted to disk, verification correctly stopped at the missing-file gate rather than falsely passing or failing on numerical quality the agent never submitted.
